# Check registry {#check-registry}

Every check a rule pack may name in `check`, generated from the registry of this NeuroGrid version (`neurogrid.checks.registry`). A rule pack uses only registered checks and only their declared parameters (A-13); a parameter value comes from `neurogrid.toml` (`[rules."ID".params]`), else from the rule pack, else from the default below.

## ai.class_balance {#ai.class_balance}

| | |
|---|---|
| Title | Class share |
| Parameters | `min_share` (number, default 0.05) |
| Passes when | the class reaches at least `min_share` of its scope; for a withheld label source (cells below 5 subjects) only what the subject numbers alone show (A-81) |
| Measured on | each scope of the label source (all, train, val, test) and class |
| Built-in rules | [CORE-M11-01](rules.md#CORE-M11-01) |
